description: This file defines the UpDownSandbox class, which extends FrameHelper and creates a Swing UI to visualize engine report data using UpDownImage. It parses a report string, constructs EngineChart and EngineReport objects, and displays an image panel. It also contains a main method to run the sandbox.

classes.name: UpDownSandbox
classes.description: A Swing application class for visualizing engine report data with a graphical image panel.

methods.name: UpDownSandbox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI with parsed engine report data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the sandbox application using SwingUtilities to ensure thread safety.
